message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"The symmetric_preadd structure already dominates direct with identical numerical quality (same error energy and SQNR) but much lower mapped area (8520.25 vs 12782.90 um^2), so architecture switching is exhausted. Decreasing coefficient fractional precision is the best remaining lever: it can reduce area further while the current SQNR of 85.14 dB provides ample margin to absorb a modest numerical-quality loss."}
